name: sota-anchor
description: Finds the libraries, tools and research released after your coding agent's training, before it rebuilds them from scratch. When a plan assumes something is unavailable - a library, a reader for a format only the vendor's software opens, a model capability - it searches the last year of papers, repositories and packages first. Also adds a dated list of current model API IDs to each session. Needs no LLM API key: this session does the reasoning, the plugin does the retrieval.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises GitHub's search limit from 10 to 30 requests a minute. Use a token with no scopes, so private repositories stay out of search results. Leave empty to search without one.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key (optional)
brave_api_key.description: Adds general web search as an evidence source. Leave empty and the web isn't searched.
